symptom: `call microflow … with (ProgressBar: Blocking)` without ProgressMessage stored Forms$MicroflowSettings.ProgressMessage as null; check, exec and mx check passed, the project opened, and Studio Pro 10.24.28 crashed exporting the page (NullReferenceException in MicroflowSettings.WriteProperties) and errored on typing in the progress-message field.
cause: The writer set ProgressMessage only when the script gave one; RegisterTypeDefaults lists it under NullFields, which is right only for ProgressBar None.
insight: **Null is a valid default only for the value of the enum it belongs to.** The reporter's census of a real 10.24 project (None+null 210, Blocking+Text 22, NonBlocking+Text 11, Blocking+null 2 — both mxcli's, both crashing) is the evidence; MxBuild 11.12.6 --target=deploy built both shapes without error, so the crash lives in Studio Pro's export, which no headless check here reaches. Decide such a default from Studio Pro's stored data, not from what the checker accepts.
